 Tennis Picks
 Fresh off a quarterfinal run in Wuhan, Ann Li is poised to produce a straight-set win over Emerson Jones in the first round of the 2026 Japan Open – Osaka.
 Current Form:
 Ann Li is coming off a terrific run at the 2026 Wuhan Open, where she rattled off three wins – including a mammoth victory over Aryna Sabalenka 3-6, 6-4, 7-6 in the second round. Li had also dispatched Camila Osorio 6-1, 3-0 ret. and Janice Tjen 6-1, 7-6 before falling to Iga Swiatek in the quarterfinals, 6-4, 6-1.
 Emerson Jones qualified for the Ningbo Open after downing Heather Watson 6-3, 6-3 and Taylah Preston 6-0 ret. The 18-year-old Jones currently ranks 134th in the world and carries a 26-17 record on hard court in 2026.
 The Matchup: Jones is +239 on the moneyline ahead of her first meeting with Li on the WTA Tour.

 Our Ann Li vs Emerson Jones Prediction
